title: Newest Kettlebell Power Circuit
intent: The three most recent kettlebell guides in the library, combined into one flowing circuit: learn the swing with Pavel's towel feedback, press with elbow-forward control, then get dense with a snatch-press-lunge triplet. Posture + physique in ~20 minutes with one bell.

cues: Towel near the handle, arms long and relaxed
Flat back, deadlift the bell
Feel the hinge — hips back, not knees forward
Hip drive, not arm lift
If the bell twists/towel slackens, reset
Chest tall, soft knees
Thumb toward you, elbow on rib cage
Bell rests in the rack, wrist neutral
Breathe before the press

steps.card: Press Overhead — Elbow Forward Both Ways
cues: Elbow forward as the bell rises
Control on the way down — no dump
Still torso, no lean
One clean motion to lockout
Stay tight through the middle
Clean to rack, then strict press
No leg drive on the press
Offset hold challenges core
Reverse lunge, knee tracks over toes
Stay upright through the torso

title: 5 Knee Mobility Exercises at Your Desk
intent: Knee rehab that fits a workday: five moves you can do at your desk or by a wall — backwards walking for warm-up, wall sits, banded knee extensions, straight-leg raises, and a hip-flexor reset. No sweat, no equipment (or a band), all aimed at knee health + posture while you sit.

cues: Walk backward down a hallway
Slow, deliberate steps
Great off-loading warm-up for knees

steps.card: Wall Sit with Ball Between Knees
cues: Ball between knees, on toes
Sit into the wall, knees at 90°
Squeeze the ball gently
Band around ankle, straighten against tension
Feel the teardrop (VMO) fire
Slow return, no snap

steps.card: Lying Knee Bends + Straight Leg Lifts (Toes In)
cues: On the floor or mat by your desk
Bend knees fully, then straight
Toes in on leg lifts to bias the VMO

steps.card: Was I started training my hip flexors.
cues: Last but biggest: train the hip flexors
Half-kneeling hip flexor stretch at your desk
Knee health rides on hip mobility

title: 3-Move Morning Mat Mobility — Ground & Align
intent: A grounding 3-move morning reset on a mat (no equipment): deep squat hold to open hips and ankles, 90/90 switches for pelvic rotation, and the chair-assisted posterior-tilt breath to re-align posture before the day. Posture, pelvis, and gait all get a wake-up in 10 minutes.

cues: Feet flat, arms forward for balance
Settle into the bottom — relax the hips
Open the ankles and groin gently
Seated 90/90, switch sides slowly
Keep the chest tall
Rotate from the hips, not the spine
Drag heels into the chair
Hamstrings engage, pelvis rolls back
Low back flattens — 2/10 effort
Exhale open-mouth 5–10s, jaw relaxed
Side abs engage at the end
Inhale through the nose — rib cage opens, no neck tension
